suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as rare infection complication. Require documented Brucella infection and separately confirmed Brucella infective endocarditis; strongest source phenotype is prosthetic-valve endocarditis. Rare case-report/case-series evidence; do not infer endocarditis from uncomplicated brucellosis. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Brucellosis and Pericarditis / Endocarditis / Myocarditis
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
